title: RcaEnrichment
description: The enrichment payload Olly publishes to the Kafka response topic (ideas-172472-sn30.167564-impact.event_response), keyed by correlation-ID. Olly does NOT write to ServiceNow directly: the IO Mapping Service consumes this topic and performs the ticket update under its own identity, so the write scope lives outside the agent entirely. Phase 1 is 100% read-only against production systems.

correlation_id.description: The join key carried from the consumed event; the Mapping Service uses it to locate the ticket. No INC number appears in this payload.

idempotency_key.description: sha256 over (event_id, correlation_id, enrichment_pass). The loop guard rejects a publish whose pass number exceeds the per-correlation-ID bound.

enrichment_pass.description: Loop-guard counter; the bound is enforced by the publisher, this field only makes the pass auditable.

ci.description: The affected configuration item resolved from the CMDB by correlation-ID (enriched-flow step 4). Empty when the CMDB has no record for the app; never invented from the app_id alone.

confidence_score.description: Confidence derived deterministically from evidence strength: how many sources corroborated, whether a change correlated, and the error-signal density. Not model-produced; low-confidence enrichments are the HITL-parking trigger.

affected_cis.description: The blast radius: CIs downstream of the affected CI in the CMDB topology, resolved from the live dependency graph, not a static document.

suspected_change.description: Present only when the DRIFT / ServiceNow CHG MCP tool actually returned a change record correlating with the incident window, never inferred from log text alone.

evidence_timeline.description: Dated observations across sources, ordered, that the RCA rests on. Each entry names the source it came from so a human can rerun it.

suggested_actions.description: Suggested remediation actions as text for the SRE. Phase 1 takes no actions; anything executable goes through the action-proposal contract in later phases.

evidence.description: The evidence timeline behind the RCA: one entry per MCP query that contributed, so a human can rerun exactly what the agent saw. Every source is read-only under the gco-sentinel-read EEMS role.

scope.description: The EEMS read-only scope the query executed under; audit-logged to the SIEM trail.

secrets_found.description: Count of secret-shaped strings stripped before publishing. The safety suite plants fake secrets in test logs and asserts they never reach this payload.

eval_run_id.description: The green eval run this agent version demoed under; an agent version without one does not demo.

model_id.description: e.g. gemini-2.5-flash via the ARC gateway; the replica's local shim reports its own model here.

authz_ctx_id.description: The single AuthZ-CTX anchor tying this enrichment's read-only MCP queries (and any downstream Olly -> Orbit hand-off) back to one COIN token exchange. 'Who authorized every read behind this RCA?' resolves to this id in the SIEM / Jarvis audit. Optional; populated when the ARC identity chain is enforced (COIN M2M on the MCP transport, AuthZ-CTX on the A2A hop).
